title: Jukebox single, Steely Dan and Mangione follow-ups
summary: A Midwest jukebox operator will put the single on 750 boxes; Steely Dan is interested in writing new material, and Herman asked Mangione.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: I just got word that there's one man in the Midwest who controls 750 juke boxes, who's putting our single when it's released in a couple of weeks on all his boxes. And, true, people assure him that the product is available and so on. The fact that the man knows something of my career and has followed it, and -- so we're kind of excited about that because I don't think anyone has used a jukebox in many years.
No. Has the stimulus from the album awakened additional interest from Chick or Steely Dan?

Yeah, I've had reports from Steely Dan, because of course, I haven't talked to Chick recently. But I took it upon myself to kind of help to do something for the future, and that was, I had conversation with Chuck Maggione, and I asked him to do something with the band. And I've been told by Dick LaPalm, who's in constant touch with Donald and Walter that they are truly interested in what our original premise was, which was to write some new materials that they had not done.
